svg.title: Testing the two parts of Harper’s statement
svg.desc: Accept adaptation: An accessible bus route can serve older patients and young families.. Question a uniform threshold: A single retirement age hides differences in health and work history.. Separate support from a target: Reliable childcare expands choice while the decision belongs to parents.

g.text: Testing the two parts of Harper’s statement
An accessible bus route can serve older patients and young families.
A single retirement age hides differences in health and work history.
Reliable childcare expands choice while the decision belongs to parents.
